en.text: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

zhSimplified.text: 这事以后，耶稣渡过，就是。

zhTraditional.text: 這事以後，耶穌渡過，就是。

en.text: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

zhSimplified.text: 有许多人因为看见他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。

en.text: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣上了山，和门徒一同坐在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裏。

en.text: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

zhSimplified.text: 那时人的逾越节近了。

zhTraditional.text: 那時人的逾越節近了。

en.text: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, Whereare we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣举目看见许多人来，就对说：「我们从哪里买饼叫这些人吃呢？」（

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對說：「我們從哪裏買餅叫這些人吃呢？」（

en.text: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

zhSimplified.text: 他说这话是要试验；他自己原知道要怎样行。）

zhTraditional.text: 他說這話是要試驗；他自己原知道要怎樣行。）

en.text: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

footnotes.text: 6:7 A denarius was a silver coin worth about a day’s wages for an agricultural laborer, so 200 denarii would be between 6 and 7 month’s pay.

zhSimplified.text: 回答说：「就是二十两银子的饼，叫他们各人吃一点也是不够的。」

zhTraditional.text: 回答說：「就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。」

en.text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

zhSimplified.text: 有一个门徒，就是的兄弟，对耶稣说：

zhTraditional.text: 有一個門徒，就是的兄弟，對耶穌說：

en.text: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

zhSimplified.text: 「在这里有一个孩童，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼，只是分给这许多人还算什么呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 「在這裏有一個孩童，帶着五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？」

en.text: Jesus said, Havethe people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们叫众人坐下。」原来那地方的草多，众人就坐下，数目约有五千。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們叫眾人坐下。」原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。

en.text: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐着的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨着他們所要的。

en.text: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, Gatherup the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们吃饱了，耶稣对门徒说：「把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得有糟蹋的。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：「把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。」

en.text: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

zhSimplified.text: 他们便将那五个大麦饼的零碎，就是众人吃了剩下的，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

zhTraditional.text: 他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。

en.text: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

zhSimplified.text: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说：「这真是那要到世间来的先知！」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」

en.text: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣既知道众人要来强逼他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。 （太14·22—33；可6·45—52）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。 （太14‧22－33；可6‧45－52）

en.text: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 到了晚上，他的门徒下海边去，

zhTraditional.text: 到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，

en.text: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

zhSimplified.text: 上了船，要过海往去。天已经黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。

zhTraditional.text: 上了船，要過海往去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裏。

en.text: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然狂风大作，海就翻腾起来。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。

en.text: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

footnotes.text: 6:19 25 to 30 stadia is about 5 to 6 kilometers or about 3 to 4 miles

zhSimplified.text: 门徒摇橹，约行了十里多路，看见耶稣在海面上走，渐渐近了船，他们就害怕。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。

en.text: But he said to them, Itis I. tbe afraid.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「是我，不要怕！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「是我，不要怕！」

en.text: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒就喜欢接他上船，船立时到了他们所要去的地方。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。

en.text: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

zhSimplified.text: 第二日，站在海那边的众人知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。

zhTraditional.text: 第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裏沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。

en.text: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，有几只小船从来，靠近主祝谢后吃的地方。

zhTraditional.text: 然而，有幾隻小船從來，靠近主祝謝後吃的地方。

en.text: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 众人见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上了船，往去找耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裏，就上了船，往去找耶穌。

en.text: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

zhSimplified.text: 既在海那边找着了，就对他说：「拉比，是几时到这里来的？」

zhTraditional.text: 既在海那邊找着了，就對他說：「拉比，是幾時到這裏來的？」

en.text: Jesus answered them, Mostcertainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们找我，并不是因见了神迹，乃是因吃饼得饱。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。

en.text: twork for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

zhSimplified.text: 不要为那必坏的食物劳力，要为那存到永生的食物劳力，就是人子要赐给你们的，因为人子是父 神所印证的。」

zhTraditional.text: 不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父上帝所印證的。」

en.text: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

zhSimplified.text: 众人问他说：「我们当行什么才算做 神的工呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人問他說：「我們當行甚麼才算做上帝的工呢？」

en.text: Jesus answered them, Thisis the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「信 神所差来的，这就是做 神的工。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「信上帝所差來的，這就是做上帝的工。」

en.text: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

zhSimplified.text: 他们又说：「你行什么神迹，叫我们看见就信你；你到底做什么事呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他們又說：「你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？

en.text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

footnotes.text: 6:31 Greek and Hebrew use the same word for “heaven”, “the heavens”, “the sky”, and “the air”.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如写着说：『他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。』」

zhTraditional.text: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如寫着說：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」

en.text: Jesus therefore said to them, Mostcertainly, I tell you, it wasn’ t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，那从天上来的粮不是赐给你们的，乃是我父将天上来的真粮赐给你们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。

en.text: Forthe bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为 神的粮就是那从天上降下来、赐生命给世界的。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為上帝的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。」

en.text: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「主啊，常将这粮赐给我们！」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「主啊，常將這糧賜給我們！」

en.text: Jesus said to them, Iam the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我就是生命的粮。到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我就是生命的糧。到我這裏來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。

en.text: ButI told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

zhSimplified.text: 只是我对你们说过，你们已经看见我，还是不信。

zhTraditional.text: 只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。

en.text: Allthose whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

zhSimplified.text: 凡父所赐给我的人必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我总不丢弃他。

zhTraditional.text: 凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裏來；到我這裏來的，我總不丟棄他。

en.text: ForI have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我从天上降下来，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我来者的意思行。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。

en.text: Thisis the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

zhSimplified.text: 差我来者的意思就是：他所赐给我的，叫我一个也不失落，在末日却叫他复活。

zhTraditional.text: 差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。

en.text: Thisis the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为我父的意思是叫一切见子而信的人得永生，并且在末日我要叫他复活。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。」

en.text: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, Iam the bread which came down out of heaven.”

zhSimplified.text: 人因为耶稣说「我是从天上降下来的粮」，就私下议论他，

zhTraditional.text: 人因為耶穌說「我是從天上降下來的糧」，就私下議論他，

en.text: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, Ihave come down out of heaven’?”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「这不是的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们岂不认得吗？他如今怎么说『我是从天上降下来的』呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「這不是的兒子耶穌嗎？他的父母我們豈不認得嗎？他如今怎麼說『我是從天上降下來的』呢？」

en.text: Therefore Jesus answered them, murmuramong yourselves.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「你们不要大家议论。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「你們不要大家議論。

en.text: Noone can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

zhSimplified.text: 若不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有能到我这里来的；，在末日我要叫他复活。

zhTraditional.text: 若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裏來的；，在末日我要叫他復活。

en.text: Itis written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Thereforeeveryone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

zhSimplified.text: 在先知书上写着说：『他们都要蒙 神的教训。』凡听见父又学习的，就到我这里来。

zhTraditional.text: 在先知書上寫着說：『他們都要蒙上帝的教訓。』凡聽見父又學習的，就到我這裏來。

en.text: Notthat anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

zhSimplified.text: 这不是说有人看见过父，惟独从 神来的，他看见过父。

zhTraditional.text: 這不是說有人看見過父，惟獨從上帝來的，他看見過父。

en.text: certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

zhSimplified.text: 我实实在在地告诉你们，信的人有永生。

zhTraditional.text: 我實實在在地告訴你們，信的人有永生。

en.text: Iam the bread of life.

zhSimplified.text: 我就是生命的粮。

zhTraditional.text: 我就是生命的糧。

en.text: Yourfathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

zhSimplified.text: 你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。

en.text: Thisis the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

zhSimplified.text: 这是从天上降下来的粮，叫人吃了就不死。

zhTraditional.text: 這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。

en.text: Iam the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

zhSimplified.text: 我是从天上降下来生命的粮；人若吃这粮，就必永远活着。我所要赐的粮就是我的肉，为世人之生命所赐的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活着。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。」

en.text: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

zhSimplified.text: 因此，人彼此争论说：「这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 因此，人彼此爭論說：「這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？」

en.text: Jesus therefore said to them, certainlyI tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’ t have life in yourselves.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裏面。

en.text: Hewho eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

zhSimplified.text: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他复活。

zhTraditional.text: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。

en.text: Formy flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

zhSimplified.text: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。

zhTraditional.text: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。

en.text: Hewho eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

zhSimplified.text: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我里面，我也常在他里面。

zhTraditional.text: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裏面，我也常在他裏面。

en.text: Asthe living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

zhSimplified.text: 永活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着；照样，吃我的人也要因我活着。

zhTraditional.text: 永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活着；照樣，吃我的人也要因我活着。

en.text: Thisis the bread which came down out of heaven —not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

zhSimplified.text: 这就是从天上降下来的粮。吃这粮的人就永远活着，不像祖宗吃过还是死了。」

zhTraditional.text: 這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活着，不像祖宗吃過還是死了。」

en.text: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

zhSimplified.text: 这些话是耶稣在会堂里教训人说的。

zhTraditional.text: 這些話是耶穌在會堂裏教訓人說的。

en.text: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

zhSimplified.text: 他的门徒中有好些人听见了，就说：「这话甚难，谁能听呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：「這話甚難，誰能聽呢？」

en.text: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, Doesthis cause you to stumble?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣心里知道门徒为这话议论，就对他们说：「这话是叫你们厌弃吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：「這話是叫你們厭棄嗎？

en.text: Thenwhat if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

zhSimplified.text: 倘或你们看见人子升到他原来所在之处，怎么样呢？

zhTraditional.text: 倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？

en.text: Itis the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

zhSimplified.text: 叫人活着的乃是灵，肉体是无益的。我对你们所说的话就是灵，就是生命。

zhTraditional.text: 叫人活着的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。

en.text: Butthere are some of you who don’ t believe.”For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

zhSimplified.text: 只是你们中间有不信的人。」耶稣从起头就知道谁不信他，谁要卖他。

zhTraditional.text: 只是你們中間有不信的人。」耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。

en.text: He said, Forthis cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又说：「所以我对你们说过，若不是蒙我父的恩赐，没有人能到我这里来。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又說：「所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裏來。」

en.text: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

zhSimplified.text: 从此，他门徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。

zhTraditional.text: 從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。

en.text: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, Youdon’ t also want to go away, do you?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就对那十二个门徒说：「你们也要去吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：「你們也要去嗎？」

en.text: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

zhSimplified.text: 回答说：「主啊，你有永生之道，我们还归从谁呢？

zhTraditional.text: 回答說：「主啊，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？

en.text: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们已经信了，又知道你是 神的圣者。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們已經信了，又知道你是上帝的聖者。」

en.text: Jesus answered them, tI choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我不是拣选了你们十二个门徒吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒嗎？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。」

en.text: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣这话是指着人的儿子说的；他本是十二个门徒里的一个，后来要卖耶稣的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌這話是指着人的兒子說的；他本是十二個門徒裏的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
